learning_outcomes.statement: The learner can build a Tkinter window with widgets, correctly distinguish event-driven from sequential execution, and lay out forms using pack()/grid() (including adaptive weight/sticky) without mixing geometry managers in one parent.

The learner can use dialogs (messagebox/filedialog) correctly by checking their actual return values, use after() instead of time.sleep() to avoid freezing the interface, and structure a real application as a class combining validated input, pure domain logic, and JSON-based settings persistence.
